description:
Existing Telegram real-attachment regression cannot obtain transport requirements from the installed Jido.Chat.Telegram.Adapter (dependency jido_chat_telegram 1.2.1). Code.ensure_loaded!/1 plus function_exported?(..., :file_requirements, 1) returns false. At baseline 14fee186e, JidoChatBridge.adapter_file_requirements returns unsupported when callback is absent; FileRequirements.validate(nil) produces configuration failure and direct planner default :abort rejects the attempt. The existing TelegramHistoryDeliveryTest document-byte assertion therefore conflicts with that baseline contract. zaq-1lw.20 retains the assertion; its agreed consistent default :continue now reports a partial text-only configuration outcome instead of guessing limits.

Scope here is investigation/contract agreement only until separately authorized. Determine supported provider requirements contract, source accurate limits without guessing, and decide ownership/pinned dependency adoption. Do not weaken or skip the existing sendDocument/exact-byte assertions, silently rename upstream callbacks, publish dependencies, or add host fallback limits merely to pass tests.

Validation: existing test/zaq/channels/telegram_history_delivery_test.exs: real document bytes, filename, caption, confirmed provider ID and no duplicate sends; then relevant Jido requirements and channel suites. Action reuse assessment: inspect existing adapter.file_requirements/1 and host transport_requirements/2 normalization; extend the existing provider/bridge contract rather than a parallel delivery path. Requires separate agreed behavior and existing-test expectation approval if any expectations change. No dependency or code publication authorized.

comments.text: Baseline execution reproduced in an isolated Elixir VM: loaded original Outgoing, FileRequirements, Step, DeliveryPlan, DeliveryFiles and JidoChatBridge from HEAD=14fee186e with unchanged installed dependencies, then sent a synthetic Telegram attachment without network I/O. Result: {:error, DeliveryError{reason: :invalid_file_requirements, stage: :configuration, delivery: :not_sent}}. Current adapter callback export check is false. This proves the existing real-document test conflict predates zaq-1lw.20. Probe source stayed under /tmp and no baseline module was written into repository/build BEAM files.

title: [zaq-1lw.21] Reconcile Telegram attachment transport requirements
